annotations.title: wakehealth.edu Reviews: Is this site a scam or legit? – Scam Detector

content.text:
`wakehealth.edu` is the official website domain for **Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist**, an academic medical center and health system based in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. It is associated with **Wake Forest University School of Medicine** and Wake Forest Baptist health services.

If you’re asking whether it’s legitimate: **yes, it appears to be a legitimate .edu healthcare domain**, not a random commercial site. Third-party domain checks also associate it with Wake Forest University / Wake Forest Baptist. ([scam-detector.com](https://www.scam-detector.com/validator/wakehealth-edu-review/?utm_source=openai))

If you meant something specific—like logging in, checking if an email from `@wakehealth.edu` is safe, finding a doctor, billing, or MyChart—tell me what you’re trying to do.
